verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a dedicated Tools tab for enabling function/API-calling workflows on an agent (bolna-docs-31) and API-driven multi-step workflows combining voice calls with API calls (bolna-docs-12), implying mid-call external calls are supported. However, there is no evidence describing how the agent handles latency during a function call (e.g., filler speech or streaming to avoid dead air), nor detailed docs on defining custom functions/schemas. Missing for 10: documentation of latency-masking/filler-audio behavior during tool calls, explicit custom function definition API/schema docs, and independent/hands-on confirmation of smooth mid-call function results.
